snippet.title: Rocket League® - Hot Wheels® Triple Threat DLC Pack Trailer
snippet.description:
Challenge accepted. Celebrate the 50th anniversary of Hot Wheels® with the Triple Threat DLC Pack! The new pack is out September 24 and includes the sleek and powerful street machines: Gazella GT™, MR11, and Fast FWD.

Learn more: https://www.rocketleague.com/game-info/hotwheels

Gameplay Credit: JSTN (https://www.twitch.tv/ItsJSTN / https://twitter.com/its_jstn)

Music Credit: Muzzy's "Horsepower" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C9ImBB5vV8c)
